## About
Merrill Auto Electric is a family owned shop with ties to the Lakewood community. We grew out of the Merrill Axle and Wheel Repair Shop as cars filled up with computer modules and more complicated electrical systems, and electrical work is still what we're known for.
Our technicians are Master ASE or ASE certified, and we use current diagnostic equipment so you aren't paying for guesswork. We also listen to you, because common sense matters as much as the computer. When we work on your car, we explain what's going on so you understand the vehicle you drive.
We're a AAA repair facility and a NAPA Car Care Center, and our customers have given us a 4.6 rating across 220 Google reviews.

## Services
- Auto electrical service: Starters, alternators, generators, electrical inspections, battery service and sales, and dash rewiring.
- Wiring repairs: Wiring repairs that are soldered and sealed with heat shrink tubing.
- Computer diagnostics: Modern diagnostic equipment to track down engine and electrical problems in today's vehicles.
- RV and trailer wiring: Wiring and repair for RVs, boat trailers and other trailers.
- Brake repair and maintenance: Complete brake repair and maintenance, plus ABS electric module work.
- Uber and Lyft vehicle inspection: Free vehicle inspections for Uber and Lyft drivers.
- Used car inspections: Have a used car checked before you buy. DOT inspections are available too.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed on weekends.

Q: Can I schedule an appointment online?
A: Yes, you can book your appointment online.

Q: What if you don't offer the service I need?
A: Give us a call and ask. If we don't do it, we can likely point you to someone who does.

They checked the voltage and integrity of the battery and cables, and asked if I wanted to replace the battery because it may be a factor in the bad (voltage) reading. I said yes, and I agreed to have them replace the battery terminals and fix the grounding cable. Ever since then, I can leave my car not driven for days and there is no problem! No more having to disconnect my terminals every night and connect them whenever I need to drive my car!
